name: mod-consumer
description: Near-instant trigger for the moderation analyst: a filtered Jetstream subscription for public mentions and a 2s chat.bsky.convo.getLog poll for DMs, both calling the same answering code as api/mod-agent.js. Runs on the DigitalOcean droplet alongside the anisota, tracker and turtle consumers.

comments.dependencies: There are none, on purpose. The answering code, the AI SDK and @atproto/api resolve from the repo root's node_modules because this service lives inside the repo and imports those modules directly — which is what keeps it from drifting from the serverless path. WebSocket is built into Node 22, so `ws` is unnecessary, and systemd's EnvironmentFile reads .env, so `dotenv` is too. Install at the REPO ROOT, not here: npm ci --omit=dev
